facts.event: 天亮后 Tilde 与 Cynghal 宫廷在 kithwood 中醒来，她听见 Ways 与祖先的喧哗，确认叛军不在近处，认定结界的升起是警告与报复
facts.numbers: days now of naught but sour meat and ale
facts.anchor: The morning came blue, and broke golden over the tops of the trees.

facts.event: Liran 伸手扶 Tilde 上马，口称 my queen，暂时对她温和，随后要众人重新祈祷
facts.relation: Tilde—Liran（王与后；她假意顺从以自保）
facts.anchor: He offered his hand to me. ‘Come, my queen, let me help you.’

facts.event: 八岁的王子 Hein 抢先放箭，一箭射穿白兔的眼睛，Egil 称赞他好箭法，Tilde 暗暗皱眉
facts.anchor: another arrow flew, cutting through my secret wish, and struck the creature through the eye.

facts.event: Tilde 当场断定那只白兔是 kithwood 设的试探，而宫廷已经失败，林子开始发出 ours 的嘶声
facts.anchor: It had been a test. I had known as soon as I saw it.

facts.event: Merovin 几天前递给 Tilde 一张纸条，对照他挂坠盒里的密信，纸上只有两个词：Be ready
facts.relation: Tilde—Merovin（Merogian 旧识，她恨他但仍倚为内应）
facts.anchor: Measured against Merovin’s locket, it only had two words.

facts.event: 队伍在鹿径中撞上手臂粗的荆棘丛，玫瑰与蔷薇果同时开放，Tilde 立刻想到 Sanafin，Marolyn 伸手握住她的手
facts.anchor: in the middle of it had grown a thicket of briars, branches thick as arms

facts.event: 林子发动：所有火把同时熄灭，一头狼把掉队者拖进黑暗，马匹惊跳，Egil 被掀下马，恐慌蔓延
facts.anchor: I saw a shot of silver as a wolf dragged a straggler into the dark.

facts.event: Tilde 抓住一根荆棘枝缠上手臂放血立约，献出 Sanafin 那个夏日之吻的记忆，换来一条通路并高唱 Cynghal 歌谣把宫廷带出林子
facts.anchor: I took hold of a branch of thorns, dragging them out of the wood.
